position_heading.name: position_heading
position_heading.default:
'Architecture begins with what
is already there and makes room
for what comes next.'

position_description_primary.name: position_description_primary
position_description_primary.default: 'We start with climate, terrain, movement, views, and the routines that give a place its character.'

position_description_secondary.name: position_description_secondary
position_description_secondary.default: 'Plans are reduced until structure, material, and daily use read as one clear idea. The result is quiet by design: spaces shaped by proportion, daylight, and the way they are lived in.'

practice_description_primary.name: practice_description_primary
practice_description_primary.default: 'A connected practice across buildings, interiors, and landscapes.'

practice_description_secondary.name: practice_description_secondary
practice_description_secondary.default: 'Each is shaped around how places are actually lived in.'

people_description.name: people_description
people_description.default: 'Two independent ways of seeing, held together by a shared commitment to clarity, material, and the life of each place.'

closing_heading.name: closing_heading
closing_heading.default:
'Made to hold the
life that follows.'
